title: Trench load modified for flexible conduits

symbols.definition: Outside width of the conduit in m

applicability: Equation 3.29 gives the total vertical load due to backfill in the horizontal plane at the top of the conduit if the pipe is rigid. For flexible conduits, the formula is modified as shown.
